title: Pay with PayPal for US$10 off US$100 Spend @ AliExpress
body:
Deal: Pay with PayPal for US$10 off US$100 Spend @ AliExpress

[BigBirdy] US$10 or AU$12? Conversion rate a bit wacky
[hybir] I pay by AUD and it gave me a flat AU$12 discount.
[Clear] Until it goes out of whack from exchange rate changes. Then people will complain to me and it's like "well did you read the part of the deal that talks about AUD?" Nooooooooope.
[Lizard Spock] I appreciate the jv professor Farnsworth.
[lanz] Specifically the offer shows up at the Checkout. Under Payment Method:
Get AU$12 off AU$120+ orders, AU$22 off AU$220+ orders, or AU$45 off on AU$350+ orders, or AU$60 on AU$520+ orders. Max 6,024 rewards. Ends 26/08/2026. T&Cs apply.
Tried it yesterday - it doesn't work. I had AU$180+ with GST to pay even with all their discount codes. Spent 30mins with customer service asking why it hadn't been discounted. They asked me to make a new order over $120 to "see" the discount, no change still no discount.
I asked to see the T&C's those were the "only" conditions lol.
At the end the lady on the other end couldn't do anything and couldn't guarantee the AU$12 off and went to tell the systems people.
[Clear] I say the below plus all the other warnings all over my deals for a reason.
Minimum spend excludes GST and shipping. AUD amounts are estimates and will fluctuate due to exchange rate changes. USD amounts do not fluctuate.
[Ijustwantvr] for me last night I had $60 off, but right now its $22 off for the same cart, it was $45 earlier today. Just going down lower and lower for some reason
[carrawa] The weird one I have been noticing and need to check out what is going on is finalising and order and paying only to find a major part of your order is no longer being shown as awaiting delivery and shows up in your next cart view while shopping.
So I have no clue if the previous deal discounts applied or not as I had a solid discount on an item wiped as it did not ship or how much I ended up paying even though emails said I had ordered it.
So check your orders go through in full even after payment. As AliExpress does not give you one whole order docket but does it individually it makes it hard to track when something goes wrong and then to figure out which items were charged or not and what if any discount was applied and final price paid.
Not looking forward to this. As I don't want to do it again with this order too.
Was expecting items to arrive which now won't.
[cannot help myself] There are a limited number of redemptions (6024) for the promotion. It's reasonable to assume that each discount tier has a certain number of redemptions allowed (as in, an allocation of the 6024 total) and that one or more of the tiers were depleted within the first 36 hours. One thing I've learnt about securing discounts on Aliexpress is that you have to be quick :)
From the T&Cs -
Promotion Period. The Promotion runs from 17:00:00 (AEST) of 17 Aug 2026 to 16:59:59 (AEST) of 26 Aug 2026, inclusive, or when 6,024 rewards have been claimed, whichever is earlier. Rewards will be allocated on a first-come, first-served basis based to time of payment.
[ComfortablyNumb] Trying tonight, no discount being applied …. tried maxing the items in cart, pay later… might be gone already?
